tagline: Manhattan Associates, Inc. is a global leader in providing cloud-based supply chain commerce solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Manhattan Associates integrates AI into its cloud solutions to optimize supply chains and commerce. The percentage of cloud contracts including AI-powered features is a key indicator of customer adoption of this technology.

kpis.name: Share of cloud contracts including AI-powered features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud contracts that integrate artificial intelligence-based capabilities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the penetration of AI capabilities within Manhattan Associates' cloud offerings, reflecting customer demand for more intelligent solutions.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of customer AI adoption.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Measures the direct profitability of products and services before accounting for other operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Indicator of profitability of core operations.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Represents the profitability of the company's core activities before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: R&D investments (percentage of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Shows the proportion of revenues reinvested in developing new technologies and products.
kpis.signal: Indicator of commitment to future innovation.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to acquiring or improving long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Measures capital expenditures, often related to infrastructure expansion or modernization.
kpis.signal: Indicator of investments in future capacity.

kpis.name: Cloud subscription revenue (ARR)
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from recurring contracts, such as SaaS software subscriptions.
kpis.description: Represents revenue from cloud subscription models, essential for predictable growth in the SaaS sector.
kpis.signal: Indicator of revenue stability and predictability.

kpis.name: Total employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The number of employees reflects the scale of operations and human capital investments.
kpis.signal: Indicator of size and operational capacity.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.84 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Share of cloud contracts including AI-powered features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud contracts that integrate artificial intelligence-based capabilities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the penetration of AI capabilities within Manhattan Associates' cloud offerings, reflecting customer demand for more intelligent solutions.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of customer AI adoption.

risks.title: Dependence on cloud subscriptions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned as critical for growth. Language emphasizes dependence on generating revenue. Weighting is high because it relates to the primary business model. Positioned at the top of risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT vulnerabilities
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited with strong language (potential to compromise data protection and IT security measures). Mentioned among key risks. Context aggravated by SaaS offering. High-impact category.

risks.title: Software defects
risks.score_rationale: Recurring mention of undetected errors or bugs. Concerned language (risk of defects, delays or interruptions). High operational impact for critical customers.

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.score_rationale: Cited among key factors that may affect results. Standard language but context of dynamic technology market. Less dramatic than operational risks.

risks.title: Dependence on single business line
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a vulnerability (dependence on single business line). Total exposure to industry cycles. Major strategic risk highlighted in text.

risks.title: Risks related to generative AI
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly mentioned with cautious language (risks associated with use of generative and agentic AI). Reflects emerging exposure. High weighting due to AI innovation at the core of MANH.

risks.title: Geopolitical instability
risks.score_rationale: Cited with concrete examples (wars in Ukraine and Middle East). Serious but generic language. Indirect impact through international operations and international business risks.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not have significant mentions regarding AI or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report.
